question: In the last 3 months, have you had a headache that limited your work, study or daily activities for a day or more?
source_idea: Samir et al. 2025 (MS-Q screening); Almomani et al. 2025 (ID-Migraine)

question: Do you feel nauseated or sick to your stomach when you have a headache?
source_idea: Almomani et al. 2025 (ID-Migraine); dataset symptom Nausea 98.8%

question: Does light bother you a lot more when you have a headache than when you do not have a headache?
Where is the pain usually? One side or both sides?
source_idea: Angerhoefer et al. 2025; Suwanlaong et al. 2025 (bilateral pain = missed-diagnosis risk)

question: How would you describe the pain? Pulsating/throbbing or pressing/tight?
source_idea: Angerhoefer et al. 2025 (pressing pain raised missed diagnosis in men)

question: Do you see visual disturbances (flashing lights, blind spots, zigzag lines) before or during a headache?
source_idea: Dataset: Visual is the top ML feature (importance 0.248); Rabany/Faisal: prodrome alone is weak

question: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
source_idea: Suwanlaong et al. 2025 (no worsening by activity aOR 5.09 for misdiagnosis)

question: In the last month, how often did poor sleep or irregular sleep come before a headache?
source_idea: Samir et al. 2025 (sleep 59.7%); Almomani et al. 2025 (sleep 83%); Elmazny et al. 2025 (under-sleeping 85.6%)

question: In the last month, how often did stress come before a headache?
In the last month, how often did loud noise or bright sun come before a headache?
source_idea: Samir et al. 2025 (noise 47.4%, sun 45.6%); Elmazny et al. 2025 (loud noise 84.5%)

question: Do you keep a headache diary (date, sleep, stress, food, medicine)?
source_idea: Elmazny et al. 2025 (only 18% keep a diary)

question: In the last 3 months, how many days did a headache stop you studying, working or going to class?
source_idea: Samir et al. 2025 (MIDAS disability); Almomani et al. 2025 (27.5% severe disability)

question: Have you ever seen a doctor for your headaches? If yes, who first: GP, neurologist, pharmacist, other?
source_idea: Almomani et al. 2025 (only 11.7% sought care); Suwanlaong et al. 2025 (non-neurologist first consult aOR 7.92)

question: What do you usually take for a headache? (painkiller from a shop, prescribed medicine, nothing)
source_idea: Almomani et al. 2025 (82% analgesics, mainly OTC); Barbanti/Cardona-Roca (anti-CGRP real-world evidence — ask about preventive use, do not recommend drugs)

question: Would you fill a 2-minute daily diary for 4 weeks (sleep, stress, headache, medicine, classes missed)?
source_idea: Report proposal: prospective diary cohort 150-300 students, 4-8 weeks; Faisal/Rabany forecasting idea needs daily data
